picker.crossAgentEmptyHint: Connect a {{agent}} model source on the remote device first
picker.budgetDisabledHint: This model needs an API key configured on the remote device first

contextWindowSwitch.title: This model can't fit the current conversation
contextWindowSwitch.remoteTitle: This remote model switch isn't supported
contextWindowSwitch.description: This conversation already uses {{used}}, more than the new model can hold ({{total}}, about {{pct}}%). If you switch, Cindy will make a short summary and continue. Your chat history stays; it just won't all be passed through verbatim.
contextWindowSwitch.remoteDescription: This remote task already uses {{used}} / {{total}} of the smaller model's context (about {{pct}}%), so Cindy cannot switch safely. Keep the current model or start a new task before choosing this model.

switchOutcome.applied: Model provider switch is now in effect.
switchOutcome.failed: Model provider switch failed. Choose the model again.

agentSwitch.confirmMessage: When you send the next message, {{appName}} hands the current session over to {{agent}}. The two agents may interpret context and tools differently, so confirm before choosing the target model.

agentRelocation.titleHostUnnamed: Run the Agent on the session’s computer again?
agentRelocation.message: The conversation record on the other computer can’t be moved over, so it continues from a handoff summary. Thinking and similar details may not carry over completely. Takes effect when you send the next message.

unified.resetScopeHint: Restore Recommended resets the harness, reasoning effort, and Fast. Existing favorites stay unchanged.
unified.saveFavoriteHint: Save these settings for quick access from Favorites.
unified.removeFavoriteHint: Removing the shortcut leaves your current settings unchanged.
unified.editFavoriteHint: Changes apply to this favorite only after saving. The configuration in use stays unchanged.
unified.originalFavoriteKept: Settings updated. The original favorite is unchanged.
unified.restoredHint: Recommended settings restored. Existing favorites are unchanged.
unified.favoriteRemoved: Favorite removed. Current settings are unchanged.
unified.favoriteUpdated: Favorite updated. The configuration in use is unchanged.
unified.favoriteChanged: This favorite was changed or removed. Cancel editing and reopen it to try again.
unified.favoriteExists: This configuration is already in Favorites. Cancel editing to use it.

unified.syncFailed: Favorites could not sync. Reopen the picker to retry; the remote computer may need an update.
